records.title: 虹桥机场T2的地铁线路衔接

zh.text: 在上海虹桥机场T2选择地铁出行时，可寻找2号线或10号线。
conditions: 仅适用于上海虹桥机场（SHA）2号航站楼。
出行前核对当前地铁运营公告，并按机场现场指引前往车站。
exclusions: 不能据此推断虹桥T1、浦东机场、虹桥火车站或市域机场线的衔接。
不提供当日运营、时刻、票价、步行路径、无障碍设施或赶上航班的保证。

en.text: For metro travel at Shanghai Hongqiao Airport T2, look for Line 2 or Line 10.
conditions: Applies only to Terminal 2 of Shanghai Hongqiao Airport (SHA).
Check current metro service notices before travel and follow airport signs to the station.
exclusions: Do not infer connections for Hongqiao T1, Pudong Airport, Hongqiao Railway Station or the Airport Link Line.
No guarantee of same-day service, timetables, fares, walking routes, accessibility or flight connections.
